meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把仓库里每个开着的 issue/PR 各开一个后台小任务单独分析，把带 GitHub 永久链接证据的报告写到 /tmp/时间戳/ 目录。它只读，不对 GitHub 做任何改动（不评论、不合并、不关闭、不打标签）。
howto.when: 当你提到“triage”、“triage issues”等词时触发，接管该仓库全部开放 issue 和 PR 的分类分析。

say.text: triage issues，分析这个仓库所有开着的 issue
say.note: 每个 issue 生成一份带永久链接的报告

say.text: triage PRs，逐个分析开放中的 pull request
say.note: 报告写到 /tmp 的时间戳目录

say.text: triage，把开放 issue 和 PR 一起梳理成报告
say.note: 只读，不会改动 GitHub 上任何内容

howto.what_en: After install, Claude spawns one background quick task per open issue/PR, analyzes each, and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim needs a GitHub permalink. It never comments, merges, closes, or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "triage", "triage issues", "github triage" and similar. It then classifies and analyzes all open issues and PRs of the repo.

say_en.text: triage issues, analyze every open issue in this repo
triage PRs, analyze each open pull request
say_en.note: Reports go to the /tmp timestamped folder

say_en.text: triage, report on all open issues and PRs
say_en.note: Read-only; no GitHub changes at all
